.archivara/concept_evolve.py.purpose: ConceptEvolve CLI: concept-tree exploration via OpenCode sub-agents. Supports evolve (generate cross-domain concept cards), probe (deep analysis of a bottleneck), reframe (re-cast problem in multiple domains), and walk (traverse concept paths). Launches sub-agents via `opencode run` subprocess, post-processes filesystem artifacts.

.archivara/semantic_scholar.py.purpose: Semantic Scholar API client for literature graph traversal: search, citations, references, recommendations, citation graphs, and BibTeX export. Includes retry logic with exponential backoff.

.archivara/opencode.json.purpose: OpenCode configuration: model selection (claude-opus-4-6), provider settings, permission matrix, and agent definitions. Central config for all sub-agent orchestration.

.opencode/tools/concept_evolve.ts.purpose: OpenCode tool wrapper for ConceptEvolve Python CLI. Exposes evolve/probe/reframe/walk commands as native OpenCode tools with proper argument handling.

.opencode/tools/semantic_scholar.ts.purpose: OpenCode tool wrapper for Semantic Scholar Python CLI. Exposes search/citations/references/recommend/graph/bibtex as native OpenCode tools.

.opencode/agents/concept-tree-explorer.m.purpose: Subagent definition for concept tree exploration. Read-only (no write/edit tools). Traverses concept folders, identifies missing links, proposes next experiments.

.opencode/agents/literature-graph-miner..purpose: Subagent definition for citation graph mining. Read-only. Prioritizes citation chains connecting distant domains, reports actionable leads.

.opencode/package.json.purpose: Node.js package manifest for OpenCode plugin dependencies

researcher.notes: Full tool access for research execution

writer.notes: Can query literature but not run concept evolution

reviewer.description: Peer review and quality control worker
reviewer.notes: Read-oriented with literature access for verification

concept_worker.notes: Used by concept_evolve.py sub-agents; has bash/read/write/edit/websearch/webfetch but no concept_evolve to prevent recursion

concept-tree-explorer.description: Explore concept trees and identify high-value concept paths
concept-tree-explorer.notes: Read-only subagent for tree traversal and analysis

literature-graph-miner.description: Mine citation graphs for transferable ideas and supporting evidence
literature-graph-miner.notes: Read-only subagent for citation chain discovery

stages.name: evolve
stages.description: Cross-domain concept generation. Takes a topic string, launches sub-agent to research across 3+ domains, generates 10+ concept cards with mathematical formalizations, builds semantic bridge graph, produces introspection and steering directions.
stages.caching: Results cached for 7200s (2h) based on normalized topic match
stages.locking: Uses fcntl file lock to prevent concurrent evolve runs

stages.name: probe
stages.description: Deep analysis of a specific bottleneck or sub-problem. Produces associations, forced bridges, anomaly results, steering directions, and validation checks.

stages.name: reframe
stages.description: Re-casts the problem in 8+ distinct domains. Each reframing includes domain, insight, technique, and mapping back to original problem.

stages.name: walk
stages.description: Traverses the concept tree's adjacency graph. Filters paths by optional seed concept, respects depth limits. Requires prior evolve run.

concept_evolve_pipeline.post_processing: Python creates concept folders, adjacency graph, and walk paths from sub-agent filesystem artifacts

python_cli.retry_strategy: 6 attempts with exponential backoff (0.75 * 2^attempt seconds, max 8s)

opencode_tool_wrapper.always_json: Appends --json flag for all non-bibtex commands

usage_patterns: search: Find papers by query text
citations: Get papers citing a given paper (forward graph)
references: Get papers referenced by a given paper (backward graph)
recommend: Get recommendations based on seed paper IDs
graph: Build full citation graph from seed query (roots + fanout)
bibtex: Generate BibTeX entry for a paper ID, append to sources.bib
